name: KimiDeltaAttention
description: Kimi Delta Attention的门控状态递推核心；可选QK归一化；输出序列及最终状态。
formula: Q,K optionally x/sqrt(sum(x*x)+1e-6); A=diag(exp(g_t)); Hbar=A@Hprev; r=v_t-k_t^T@Hbar; H=Hbar+beta_t*k_t@r^T; y_t=scale*q_t^T@H
shape_support: q,k,g:[B,T,H,Dk]; v:[B,T,H,Dv]; beta:[B,T,H]; state:[B,H,Dk,Dv]; equal Q/K/V head counts

inputs.name: q
inputs.description: 未归一化或按属性直接使用的查询

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: 键；归一化属于被测计算

inputs.name: g
inputs.description: 逐token逐key通道自然对数衰减；不是累计gate

inputs.name: beta
inputs.description: 直接给定写入强度[0,1]；不再sigmoid

inputs.name: initial_state
inputs.description: 必选初态；无历史时传零张量；不可原地修改

outputs.name: final_state
outputs.description: 末态；必须参与精度比较

attrs.name: use_qk_l2norm
attrs.description: 是否在核心中对Q/K按sum(x²)+1e-6归一化

attrs.name: scaleValue
attrs.description: <=0自动1/sqrt(Dk)；>0使用显式值；仅缩放读取输出

schema: kimi_delta_attention(Tensor q, Tensor k, Tensor v, Tensor g, Tensor beta, Tensor initial_state, bool use_qk_l2norm=True, float scaleValue=-1.0) -> (Tensor y, Tensor final_state)
